name: Mayan Drinking Chocolate
desc: Dark chocolate melted into non-dairy milk with cinnamon, cayenne and nutmeg.

source.title: Vegan Mayan Drinking Chocolate
source.evidence: Same name, every ingredient at the same amount (2 cups non-dairy milk, 5 oz 70% chocolate, 1/2 tsp each vanilla and cinnamon, 1/8 tsp cayenne, 1/4 tsp sea salt) and the same three-step method.

ingredients.raw: 2 cups non-dairy milk (half full-fat coconut milk, half unsweetened almond milk)
ingredients.note: half full-fat coconut milk, half unsweetened almond milk

ingredients.raw: 5 oz dairy-free dark chocolate (70% cacao), chopped
1-2 tbsp coconut sugar or raw cane sugar, to taste (optional)
ingredients.item: coconut sugar or raw cane sugar

ingredients.raw: 1/2 cup coconut whipped cream, for topping

steps: Bring the milk to a simmer in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped chocolate and whisk until it starts to melt.
Add the cinnamon, cayenne, nutmeg and salt and whisk vigorously until the chocolate is completely melted and smooth.
Remove from the heat and whisk in the vanilla.
Taste and whisk in sugar if it is not sweet enough, or a pinch more cayenne for more heat.
Pour into 4 small cups and top with coconut whipped cream.
tips: Leftovers keep covered in the refrigerator for a few days; rewarm gently over low heat.
